newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse stays closed on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse stays closed on Tuesday.

text.p: The Bucharest stock exchange said it would stay close on Tuesday for the third session in a row as it was testing newly installed software intended to improve trading and settlement.
The bourse started installing the new software last week when it had no trading.
It said it would reopen on October 3.
Bursa de Valori Bucuresti, Romania's first in 50 years, opened last November. It trades 13 of its 16 listed stocks. -- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
